Recommendations, not blocking: (1) keep the visit markers as short glows and rings at street level; do not let the pillar read as a beam into the sky, which would suggest transmission. (2) Do not add a 'now'/clock, a 'LIVE' tag or a persistent 'you are here' pulse at the end of the route; it would imply live tracking. Signed off as is.
